title: Russia Accuses NATO Member Estonia of Hostile Acts. In 1940 It Annexed Estonia #shorts
description:
This week Russia accused NATO member Estonia of hostile actions it said were on the verge of unleashing open war. In 1940, Moscow accused Estonia, Latvia and Lithuania of hostile acts, demanded new governments, sent in troops and annexed all three.
